description:
Create a hosted Stripe Checkout session ($1-$500 USD via Apple Pay, Google Pay, Link, or card) to fund a master sbk_* spend key, or claim a trial key ($0 when enabled). Use this to provision or top up an account; do not use for balances (x402_get_account) or subagents (x402_issue_delegate_key).
Parameters: pass amount_cents (100=$1, 200=$2, 500=$5, 1000=$10, 2500=$25, 5000=$50, 10000=$100, 25000=$250, 50000=$500; or 0 if trial grants enabled); omit spend_key for a new key.
Behavior: Stripe sessions expire after 31 min (max 3 open returns 409 checkout_already_open); credits settle ~4s post-payment; delegates return HTTP 403.

agent_id.description: Optional autonomous agent identifier used for Zero-PII anti-Sybil hashing when claiming an amount_cents=0 promotional trial grant.

return_surface.description: Web surface to redirect the operator to after Stripe Checkout finishes: "x402" (default), "pay" (Express Pay live balance poller), "developers", or "app".

spend_key.description: Master Stripe account spend key (format: sbk_<43+ chars>). Delegated subagent keys are rejected with HTTP 403. Optional if supplied via the x-atlas-spend-key HTTP header.

name: x402_create_checkout

account_id.description: Master account identifier that will receive the credit pack.

amount_usd.description: Formatted USD amount of the selected credit pack or trial grant.

checkout_url.description: Hosted Stripe Checkout URL for the human operator to complete payment.

ok.description: True when the Stripe Checkout session or trial grant was created.

spend_key.description: Newly generated master or trial sbk_* key.

title: Create Stripe Credit Checkout
